title: Product Hero
description: A warm, editorial introduction with a live product composition, clear calls to action and quiet social proof.
summary: Editorial split hero with a believable studio overview.

remix.name: Monograph
remix.description: Editorial: warm paper, ink type and one vermilion accent, a high-contrast serif at poster size, a masthead rule, a drop cap and the product sheet laid on a colour plate.

notes: The calls to action use placeholder fragment links. Point them at your signup and product-tour routes.
The studio overview is a static illustration of product UI; it is not wired to live data.
The sparkline is decorative and marked as an image with a summary label.
